frames.title: Lesson 142 · Sentence pattern: Cleft sentence — use

body: **Foco:** Cleft sentence — uso.
**Pronúncia:** Ritmo e ênfase para nuances.
**24 palavras novas** (filosofia).
**Texto do dia:** conto e trecho de peça.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo usar frases clivadas (It was… that…; What… was…; All I… is…) para enfatizar informações, em um conto ou cena de teatro.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Story: The Unanswered Letter
paras: It was **not the silence** that hurt Clara; it was **the politeness** with which her brother had **stopped writing**. **What she wanted was** an argument, **a quarrel**, **anything** that proved he still cared.

**It was in the attic**, among his old philosophy books, **that she found** the letter. **All she had to do was** open it. **What stopped her was** a single line on the envelope: *Read this when you are ready to forgive me.*

**It was then that** she understood: **it is not forgiveness that** takes courage, **but admitting that one needs it**. **What she did next** surprised even her. She sat down, **and began to write back**.

items.why: What she wanted was an argument.

items.q: She found the letter in the kitchen.
“It was in the attic that she found the letter” emphasizes…
“All she had to do was open it” = ?
items.why: All + S + had to do + was + verbo.

head: Tipo
Exemplo
Enfatiza
rows: **It was in the attic that** she found it.
**All she had to do was** open it.
**It is not** forgiveness **that** takes courage, **but** admitting need.

blocks.body: A frase clivada **divide** a frase em duas para **destacar um elemento**. Após *was* com infinitivo omita *to* (*All I did was ask*). Use sem exagero, para efeito narrativo.
Em *It was… that…* o verbo *be* fica no singular mesmo com elemento plural: *It was the books that she found.*

items.s: It was in the attic ___ she found the letter. (that)
All she had to do ___ open it. (be)
It is not forgiveness that takes courage, ___ admitting the need. (but)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: What she wanted was an argument
items.pt: O que ela queria era uma briga.

body: **It was then that** — foi então que
**What matters is** — o que importa é
**All it takes is** — basta
**The thing is** — o ponto é
**That is what** — é isso que
**It is hardly surprising that** — não surpreende que
**Make amends** — reparar
**Bury the hatchet** — enterrar o machado
**Reach out** — estender a mão
**Patch things up** — fazer as pazes
**What did Clara want?** — O que Clara queria?
**What she wanted was an argument.** — O que ela queria era uma briga.
**And where did she find the letter?** — E onde ela achou a carta?

forms: Ele lamentou a carta não enviada.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.model: It was my sister who first asked the question.
What I need is a quiet room.
All I did was ask a simple question.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence story scene using three cleft structures (It was… that…, What… was…, All… was…).
blocks.model: It was the rain that kept him indoors. What he wanted was a reason to call her. All he had to do was pick up the phone. It was then that the phone rang. What he heard was her voice, small and clear. It was not apology that he felt, but relief.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
